_comment: Which reply leads to which line. The one thing about an NPC the client has never held.
The client ships every line an NPC can say and every reply it can be given, and nowhere does
it say which goes with which - measured across all 6,467 of them. That pairing has always
lived on Ankama's server, so it cannot be extracted or measured. It has to be decided, and
this is where the decision goes.
npc         the NPC's id
map         0 for wherever it stands; a map id to say something different there
opening     which line it starts on; the first one when left out
lines       one per thing it says, each with what can be said back
next        the line that reply leads to; left out, the conversation ends
And what a reply is FOR, which is what stops a conversation offering everything at once:
startsQuest  this reply hands that quest over. Not the same as `quest`: this one is how a
quest begins, so it is offered to somebody who has NOT got it.
quest        only offered while that quest is under way.
step         and only while it is on that step.
afterQuest   only offered once the quest is finished.
Where the conversation opens, when it is not always the same line:
openings     tried in order, the first that holds wins; none, and `opening`. Each has a
`message` or a `byBreed` table (breed id to message) and any of: `before`
(quest neither started nor finished), `quest` (under way), `step` (and on that
step), `objective` (and that objective done), `after` (quest finished).
pushes       a line the NPC opens by itself, with no click, once a step of a quest ends:
`afterStep` and a `message` or `byBreed`. The tutorial's voice does it.
params       what a reply shows beside it, as effects: a number, or an array whose first
number is the effect and the rest what it names, [34, 2511] for «starts quest
{ "npc": 1088, "map": 0, "opening": 3312, "lines": [
{ "message": 6047, "choices": [ { "reply": 7846 } ] } ] }
A line with no replies is fine now: the client draws its own Leave button and the X closes the
window, because the server answers the kla it sends. It did not before, which is why an NPC
with nothing to say back used to trap you in the conversation.
WHERE THESE COME FROM. The ids are the client's own. The wiring - which reply leads where -
is read off the walkthroughs at dofuspourlesnoobs, which write the reply options out in
French, and matched back to ids with tools/dialogue_from_guide.py. Inside one NPC the text
identifies its lines 98.3% of the time, and the reply ids do not have to be Ankama's: the
server sends the ids and the client sends back what it was given, so any id with the right
text works as long as the tree agrees with itself.
mutation      the reply gives this mutation item after its teleport (the Orbalantir's).
endsMutation  the reply takes the player's mutation away after its teleport.

Back with the trafficker behind bars (36986, 13856), she has spoken of the character to his class's representative (30641) and hands «Consejo de clase» over. «¿Dónde puede uno descansar tranquilo?» is «Esto hace aguas» (30884, the line 1975 names). «Ça tombe à l'eau»: «Exponer el problema de la privatización del lago.» (13956); she knows no notary Fer Liz and the pond is public (30903); the squatters are to come and see her (30904).
«Tel est pris qui croyait prendre»: «Explicar la necesidad de carteles y folletos» (31387), and Kerubim's purse handed over (14111, 19728): he prints them at once (31388).

Kerubim Crepin, Astrub's antique dealer. «Six pieds sous terre» (Dofus pour les noobs): «Describir al hombre que ha guiado a las tres turistas» (13974): Marco Mercial (30947), the swindle he suffered too (30948), and the plan to catch him at his own game (30949, 31384-31386, the line «Tel est pris qui croyait prendre» names): «Seguiré tu plan.» hands it over with his purse for Primir (19728, the item its first objective asks for), «De momento no seguiré tu plan.» leaves it; «Escuchar su plan» takes it up again.

«Ça sent le gaz»: «Hablarle del dragón Rathrosk.» (13945), the legend of a grey squirrel (31053), the grey dragon of the city's archives (31054), and the recruit who has just come in (31055, then the recruit speaks). «Ça tombe à l'eau»: «Hablar de la estafa de la que cree ser víctima» (13964): books that fall to pieces (30926), and «Volverte hacia el forastero», Nosbro Mah, who comes in as she says it.

Paula Sepe, who is paid to find the jobless work, at the Council Tower, from her own lines and replies, by Dofus pour les noobs. «Ça sent le gaz»: the gift for the rats' chief, a smelly crate (30962, 19670), and the sewers (30963). «Crise sanitaire» («Proposer son aide»): looking for a job (30496), the peasants' troubles (30497) and Megustam Laspelas (30498, the line 1984 names); the summary (13829, 30507). «Livraison par intérim»: Estefi Dora's sick delivery man (30508, 1985's line, 30509) and the crates delivered (13835, 30519). «Golémancien»: Bajofrente's animated quintain (30522-30525, 30524 1986's line) and its delivery (13848, 30544). «Le rebelle de la forêt»: Vangey, Hel Munster's apprentice, missing (31439-31443) and Bajofrente first (31444, 1987's line, 31445); back with him, his troubles (14142, 31464, 31465), and the character turns to Vangey.

Vey Gana (Vaiguy), the cook's girl in Astrub's fields, by «Déjeuner à la fourchette» of Dofus pour les noobs: a vegetarian buffet for a sadida delegation (30402) and pieces of each plant (30403, the line 1981 names); «Darle los ingredientes.» hands the four slobbers over (13781-13784, offered once all are carried) and brings the country doll out of Mawy Ingals' barn (30404); after the fight, «Examinar su estado.» (13786) and the Hungry Sunflower Barn's key (30406).

Jeffry Baratón (Jeffrey Baratourte), in Tainela, by «La coupe des vices» of Dofus pour les noobs: he cannot stand happy gobballs (30407, 30408), «Un entrenamiento no puede ser malo.» and the massacre (30409, the line 1982 names); too green under level 20 (30410, the quest asks PL>19); the massacre reported (13791) and the Royal Gobball's Court key (30411).

Cindy Cato (Cindy Cah), Astrub's housing representative, by «Les as de la cambriole» of Dofus pour les noobs: the city's houses and their vermin (30412, 30413), a network of tiny thieves (30414) and the rikiki wands to get into their hideouts (30415); the knick-knacks to bring back (30416, the line 1983 names), and one hideout pointed out (57240). Too green under level 30 (30417). The fifteen boxes handed over (13792, offered once all fifteen are carried) and the key of a hideout another mercenary found (30418).

dialogues.why: «Consejo de clase» (2009): «Presentarte.» (37126) is this class's objective (13895, effect 30), and leads to his greeting, 30750, «La consejera Archi me ha hablado de ti», then to his class quest. «Aquí huele a gas» (1960): once his class quest (1615) is done, he greets the character with Archi's summons (30757) and «Ir a la Torre del Consejo» hands it over.

Hupe Esse (Kaulysse Himo), who delivered the books, by «Ça tombe à l'eau»: where the books came from (13966, the last objective), the goods received at the zaap and the money to the dealer there (30935, the line «Six pieds sous terre» names), and «me voy al zaap de Astrub» hands that quest over.

The mercenary recruit sent by Bajofrente, who comes into the library after Aisling's talk (Dofus pour les noobs: «Soudain une Recrue Mercenaire fait son apparition avec un message de Badufron»): «Seguir escuchando.» is 13951, and the news about the false dofus hands «Paseo por el bosque» over (31059, the line it names).

Fécaline the Sage, from her own lines and replies, paired by what they say and by Dofus pour les noobs («Le village dans les nuages», «Espoirs et tragédies», «Dans la gueule du Milimilou»). The catalogue names 20918 for 1634 and 20926 for 1635, the lines whose reply hands each over; «Destino Astrub» is handed over on her opening, 20915, the line the catalogue names, once the Minilubo's quest is done, and at the end of that quest's conversation (20929).

The captain of the kerubims, from his own lines and replies, by Dofus pour les noobs («Le village dans les nuages», «Mise à l'épreuve» to «Des chafers qui marchent»). Each report is the reply that does the «go back and see the captain» objective (effect 30) and leads to the next mission's line, the one the catalogue names; who closed the window before taking it is greeted with that line. «Proponer tus servicios.» is the trials another day; «Estoy listo para una misión.» is 1643 another day (20884-20886).

Anta Brok, from her own lines and replies, by «La galette secrète» of Dofus pour les noobs. Asked for work (25216), she asks whether the character can cook (20975) and tells of the dessert her sister dared her to make (20976, the line the catalogue names); «Yo puedo hacer la torta por ti.» hands the quest over with the secret recipe (16517), whose reading is 9805. The cake shown (25218) does 9807 and sends the character to Kotorra for jam (20978); cake and jam handed over (25224) do 9810, and Anta tastes the jam (20979): «Probar la mermelada» or not, and she keeps the cake (20981, 20982).

Marylork the painter, from his own lines and replies, by «Un peu de pigment» of Dofus pour les noobs: asked about himself he is out of green paint (21197), «Yo puedo ayudarte.» hands the quest over and he asks for aminite powder from the mines (21198); «Toma el polvo de amenita.» hands over the three powders (9970) and he thanks the character (21199).

Noken Okuto (Lykhen Lesurviven), at the village gate, from his own lines and replies. «Le village dans les nuages» per Dofus pour les noobs: he takes the character for a newcomer and sends him back to Master Joris (20776, a line from before 3.6), «Répondre que vous préférez apprendre par vous-même» (24896) and «Demander où trouver Ternette» (24893), whose answer, 20779, says her place is already marked in the quest journal. The catalogue hands the quest over on 20780 «¿Qué tenemos aquí? Otra alma aventurera...», on «¿Quién es Ternauta?»; 20777 is the same offer on the way Dofus pour les noobs describes, and hands it over on its own «¿Quién es Ternauta?». «Espoirs et tragédies»: he tells of his exploits and of the six dofus he nearly had, then laughs at the apocalypse story; 24909 leads to his farewell and is the veteran's objective (objectives.json). Who stares back (24911) hears the truth; who apologises (24907) or insults him (24913) is sent off.

Berbe Unin, from his own lines and replies, by Dofus pour les noobs («Produits naturels», «La hache et la pioche», «Boune un jour, boune toujours») and the catalogue's lines for each quest (21043, 57160, 21050, 21056, 57184). His trials go in pairs of chains: one said on the way back from the previous one («Ya he terminado.» then «Mira lo que he confeccionado/fabricado.») and one for another day («Estoy listo para otro trabajo.», «Ya puedo hacer otra tarea.»). 3.6 put «El oficio de los aventureros» (the meat broth, with his hunting knife, 30832) between the first two and «Preparación para el combate» after the Bun set; its last objective, seeing him again, is «Mira lo que he fabricado.» (19270), and the title of son of Incarnam (21068).

Ternette, the mayor, from her own lines and replies in the client, paired by what they say and by Dofus pour les noobs. Her replies come in pairs of chains: one said on the way (back from the previous errand: «He hablado con Xelora», «He conseguido encontrar cinco vestigios») and one for another day («Cuéntame más cosas sobre los dioses», «Háblame del Mundo de los Doce»); the catalogue names the second chain's line for each quest (20808, 20814, 20819). «Transporte único» is also offered from the welcome of «Un pueblo sobre las nubes», «Estoy impaciente por explorar la isla celeste» next to «Daré una vuelta por el pueblo», which is where Dofus pour les noobs has it.

The guided tutorial's Mysterious Voice, as the capture of the whole tutorial has it: 60352 «¿Estás bien?» with «Desplazarte.» (effect 2192), which starts 2545; the first steps walked (idz 3226) and the voice opens by itself on the god of the character's class, then «Basta de cháchara» and «Ver cómo se materializa un camino» (2192 twice), and the window closes. Before that fight, his «¡Adelante, sin miedo!»; with 2511 under way, «Con tu nuevo equipo...»; afterwards, the puch is there to train on.

Ganymed by the jalatós' pen, as the tutorial capture has him: after the fight (2502 on 3173) 57132 «Tus oponentes han mordido el polvo» with «Dar saltitos de impaciencia» (30 naming objective 19173, then 1142); the characteristic points still to share out (3184), the line on which element each characteristic masters; then 60411 «¿Has elegido tu vía?» with «Quedarte para entrenar» and «Unirte al maestro Curro», both showing 2192 and 34 for quest 1629, the second starting it.

Master Curro in the tutorial's jobs room, as the capture of the whole tutorial has him: 20676 «¡Saludos, joven!» with «¿Cómo va eso?», then 20677 with «¿Qué materiales me van a hacer falta?» (30 naming objective 9656 and eight 1150), then 20678 with «Explorar el lugar.» (five 1150 and 2192); once the ring is made, 20681 «¡Has trabajado muy bien, #1!», his name in it, with «Dirigirte a la salida.» showing quest 1630 and starting it. In between, the reminder of what the ring needs; afterwards, his «No hay nada como la satisfacción...».

The celestial chafer pikemen of the combat room, as the tutorial capture has them: 20706 «llama a los chafers al rescate» with «Empezar el combate contra los tres monstruos» (911, the fight of content/fights/npc_fights.json, once Master Darmas has been heard) and «Retirarte»; once beaten, «juega con su lanza».
The celestial chafer explorer of the combat room: the same fight from his «llama a los chafers como apoyo», and «se prepara para la revancha» once beaten.

Master Darmas in the combat room, as the tutorial capture has him: 20700 «Eres #1, ¿verdad?», the name in it, with «Estoy dispuesto a demostrar lo que valgo.», then 20744 with «Seguir escuchando.» (30 naming objective 9685), then 57155 with «Dirigirte hacia una criatura para provocarla.»; after the chafers, 21200 «¡Has ganado!» with «Sobresaltarte al ver aparecer a Ganymed» (350, 3007), on which Ganymed comes in (jsn, actor -20004) and speaks.

Ganymed coming into the combat room after the chafers, as the tutorial capture has him: 57149 «¡Bravo, #1!», 57220 on changing class while a novice, 57221 «Antes de que abandones el templo...» with «Seguir a Ganymed» (31 naming step 2250, 777), which takes the player to the Dofusarium (jru 241443329).

Ganymed in the Dofusarium. The tutorial capture ends on his 57150 «Aquel que quiere ver cumplido su destino...» with «Inspeccionar las seis estatuas de dofus» (34 naming 1631, then 3010), the reply that starts 1631. The rest is his own lines in the order Dofus pour les noobs gives the quest: once the statues are read, 60427 on the Dofus and the hint to the book (60428, «Consultar el libro del templo», «Ir a la próxima sala»); once the book is read, 57151 «Ha llegado el momento de que comiences tu gran viaje» with «Dirigirte a la salida del Templo Celeste»; afterwards, his farewell 57154 with the name.

Azar (Aléha), the Ecaflip of the tavern, from her own lines and replies. Her four «Lanzar los dados sobre la mesa.» on each of the two dice lines (20935 after her story, 20940 when asked straight away) are one throw: one is offered, at random, and each leads to its own result (20936-20939, 20941-20944) with its own farewell. Dofus pour les noobs: she came back to Incarnam, tells of the guardians of the dofus and has the character throw her dice.

Oscar Kasa (Oskar Khas), the thief's ghost of the phoenix rock, from his own lines and replies. «Espoirs et tragédies» per Dofus pour les noobs: asked what happened to him, he tells of the Emerald dofus he died for, smells something burning, and the evil fire that haunts him comes back; «Quedarte y luchar contra el fuego maléfico» starts the fight (npc_fights.json). The rest is his talk on death and the phoenix.

The Minilubo Albino in his lair: «Atacar al monstruo» starts the fight (npc_fights.json), «Huir de la cripta» leads back out through the grate (teleports.json). The jam pot of «La torta secreta» has its own lines (20850-20852) for whoever carries it, not written yet.

Likantrabioso (Hargnok), once the Minilubo is beaten: he was the beast, bitten by it before he killed it, and his dofus are long gone (Dofus pour les noobs, «Dans la gueule du Milimilou»). «Salir de la Cripta del Minilubo Albino» leads back out through the grate.

Master Anemó, keeper of the portal to Astrub, from his own lines and replies: whether the character wants to leave Incarnam (30374), whether the island is explored (30375, 30376), and what is past the portal, the heart of Astrub and the envoy of the gods (30377). «Destino Astrub» asks to see him (13767, done on talking to him).

Xelora Pañá, who mends the zaaps with her hammer, from her own lines and replies: where the zaaps come from (20857), how a hammer mends them (20858, 20859), the zaap's use (20860), and «Examinar el zaap justo al lado.», which is «Transporte único»'s 9815 (objectives.json).

Masvisto and his astromagic telescope, from his own lines and replies. «Me envía Ternauta.» while «Vistas celestes» wants his telescope: he asks after her (20823) and lets the character to the eyepiece (20824). Anyone else may ask for a look (20822).

Galilea and her telescope, from her own lines and replies. «Me envía Ternauta.» while «Vistas celestes» wants her telescope: the Unin family helped her build it (20828); anyone else may ask to use it (20827).

The Rata Nsiosa of the tavern's cellar, out of the tap once the lemonade has been poured (jsn of template 2912 on cell 385, facing 5, right after ieb 9769 in «mision matarratas completa»). Its only line, 20872, and «Atacar a la rata.» with effect 905, which starts the fight on 153486338 (npc_fights.json).

Kotorra (Pipelette), in the library, from her own lines and replies. «¿Tienes por ahí un tarro de mermelada para mí?» while «La torta secreta» sends the character to her (9808): her jam for nettles (20985). «Aquí tienes algunas ortigas.» hands over the five nettles (9809) and, once they are taken, her home-made jam (16509, 20986).

Chadalid (Kardorim), in the room past his own, from his own lines and replies. «Cryptologie» per Dofus pour les noobs: «demandez à Kardorim qui il est» -- «Háblame de ti.» (24993) is the visit, 9813 --; once captain of the celestial militia, raised by the graveyard's curse (20843), he tries to discipline the chafers (20844). Asked about the Minilubo (24991, 24999), he offers the way to its lair (24990, 24996, 25015, passages in teleports.json); his «Salir de la Cripta de Chadalid» replies leave the dungeon (dungeon_exits.json).

Corporal Mienerva, from her own lines and replies, by «Mise à l'épreuve» of Dofus pour les noobs: «Estoy listo para pasar el test de aptitud.» (the visit, 9828), her doubts (20906), «Protestar e insistir» and the fight (20907, «Empezar el combate.», npc_fights.json); beaten, «¿Ha sido concluyente el test?» (20909) and «Voy a ver al capitán» (9830). Who lost may try again (25093, 20908).

Kruella Troz, the vain Osamodas of «Leçon d'humilité» (Dofus pour les noobs: «Kruella vous menace de vous fouetter... Défiez alors la fougueuse Osamodas»): while the mission is on, her threat (20900) and «Desafiarla en combate uno contra uno.» (npc_fights.json); beaten, she let the character win (20901); otherwise her vanity (20903, 20902).

Percy Klópeo, the one-eyed chafer of «Des chafers qui marchent», who comes out when his tomb is searched: «Defenderte.» starts the fight (npc_fights.json), and beating him drops the jewel bag (16540, 100 % in his drops).

Tek Abir, the tavern keeper of Astrub, from his own lines and replies. «On marche sur des œufs» per Dofus pour les noobs: «Commander une bière» for 40 kamas (30385, «Son 40 kamas y aquí no se fía.»), the Cerveza de Astrub; asked about the dofus, the rumour of pandawas (30645, 30646). «Ça tombe à l'eau»: the notary's description without naming him (13958): the Duke of Sidimote, gone, but his servant Camilo Demolinos is still around (30907-30909), at the markets. «Bière qui roule n'amasse pas mousse»: «Pedir una cerveza para Bajofrente», «Aquí tienes los 40 kamas.» (« Payer les 40 kamas », 13769) for the frothy Astrub beer (19623), and hurry before the froth goes (30386). The same reply buys the ordinary beer for anybody else: the quest's comes first in the line.

Acidrik Rasgapanza, the haruspex of the tavern, from his own lines and replies: «Busco los dofus.» (Dofus pour les noobs: «Dire que vous êtes à la recherche des Dofus»), a beer for the stars (30666), and «Darle una cerveza a Acidrik.», which takes the Cerveza de Astrub and has him dance with the stars (30667-30669).

Sus Belli (Huze Belli), drinking upstairs at the tavern, from her own lines and replies. «On marche sur des œufs» per Dofus pour les noobs: told the character seeks the dofus and can pay («Prétendre que vous avez hérité d'un joli magot de la part de votre tatie»), she sends him to Nowa with the password (30684); that is «Habla con los ocupantes de la taberna para atraer la atención de un traficante» (13852).

Nowa, the pandawa who sells false dofus, from his own lines and replies, by «On marche sur des œufs» of Dofus pour les noobs: the password «La tortilla ya está lista para servirse.» (the visit, 13853), ten thousand kamas for a shining egg (30690, 30691), the threat with the weapon (37054), his ten-kama bribe and «Soy incorruptible.» (30693), and he runs: the fight (npc_fights.json). Beaten, he gives himself up (30687) and «Escoltar al pandawa hasta el jefe de la milicia»; still standing, «¿Otra vez tú?» (30688); afterwards, his trafficking days are over (30686).

The mercenary instructress of the militia's second room, from her own lines and replies, by «C'est pour ta pomme» of Dofus pour les noobs: sent by Setsinbol (14157), out of apples (31508) and off to the grocer's (31509); the rotten apples handed over (14164) make her angry and send the character to the market (31510); the apples saved from the thieves (14173) and she lets him train (31511), on the trunk in the middle of the room.
«C'est pour ta pomme»: no fresh apples, they were stolen (31512); a crate of rotten ones instead (31513, 19750), the ones he keeps for Tek Abir (31514).
«C'est pour ta pomme»: his crates of apples stolen, and a basket of tomatoes with them (31516); a free crate for whoever brings them back (31517), «Seguir el rastro de tomates.» (14166).
A tomato thief at [2,-17], knocked out (31518): asked for the crates, they were stolen from her too (31519, 14167); «Llamar a un mercenario para que las conduzca a la celda.»

The Astrub mercenary at [2,-17]: told where the thieves are (14168), he takes them in charge (31522), and the character follows the trail to the meadow («Voy a seguir el rastro de tomates en la pradera de nuevo.»).

The apple thieves loading the stolen crates near the sewer's entrance, from their own lines and replies, by Dofus pour les noobs («Flanquer une correction aux voleurs»): seen loading the crates (14170), told to go back to Astrub (31524) or mocked (31525), and the fight against three of them (npc_fights.json).

Fallanster, head of the Council of Astrub, in the council chamber upstairs (Dofus pour les noobs: «Empruntez donc les escaliers situés derrière Archie»). «Ça sent le gaz»: his welcome (30710), a neutral envoy for the Strubian rats (30957), the toxic fumes in the mines (30959), and «Estoy dispuesto a parlamentar con el jefe de las ratas.» (13901, 30960). Back with Rathrosk: «Te presento a Rathrosk.» (13943) shows him a squirrel (30961), «pedirle que se transforme» (13944) a dragon (30953); the summary (30954), the legend (30955) and Aisling at the library (30956). «Balade en forêt»: «Hablarle de la emboscada de los pandikazes» (13950); the support of the daimyo Hikomi (31066), the sacred place on Pandala (31067), the sealed message (31068, 31069, the line «Le réceptacle des Dofus» names). Put off for later, «Mencionar un viaje a la isla de Pandala» takes it up again (31075).
The hungry rats of the sewers, after the cheese: «Este regalo es para vuestro jefe.» and they would take it anyway (30965); the fight against three of them (npc_fights.json), «Ça sent le gaz».

Ramán Hitu, chief of the Strubian rats, from his own lines and replies, by «Ça sent le gaz»: once his rats are beaten, his apologies (30967); the crate from Fallanster (13935, taken), the rats' innocence (30969, 30970), the grey hairs on an old grate (30971), móguiz hair (30972), and the quarry mine to explore (30973).

A veteran móguard of the quarry's gallery, by «Ça sent le gaz»: he sends the curious away (31033, 31034); after the signalling fairy's noise (13995) he talks to the other guard (31023) and both go and see (31019, «Ver a los dos móguices alejarse.», 13937); with Rathrosk free, «¡MOGUARRRRDIAS!» and the fight.

The other veteran móguard: sends the curious back to Astrub (31038, 31039), leaves the checking to his colleague after the noise (31036), and raises the alarm when the dragon escapes (31035) — the fight.

Rathrosk, the young dragon the móguices make work in the machine room. «Ça sent le gaz»: furious móguices, he does not want to go back to work (31048); the lock broken with the móguiz pickaxe, «Rathrosk, ha llegado la hora de salir de aquí.» frees him (13939, the pickaxe taken) and he follows the character (31049, the follower 19661).

The mercenary recruit at the meeting point in Astrub's forest, from her own lines and replies, by «Balade en forêt» of Dofus pour les noobs: she shows the cart (31061); looking inside it, or seeing the silhouettes in the bushes and stepping back, is the talk (13947), and «¡Por la gloria perdida de Pandala!» (31062) opens the fight against three recruits (npc_fights.json).
Jeisi Kotsapilos, the second squatter of the pond («Ça tombe à l'eau»): a private property (30888), and the character taken for one of the mercenaries' side (30889, 30890).
Jouy Glaston, the third squatter, who wants to bathe and wash his socks in the pond («Ça tombe à l'eau»): forbidden (30892), and the character as much of a killjoy as the mercenaries (30893).

The angry mercenary woman at the pond: the fishermen pushed into it (30898), and «Voy a tratar de solucionar el problema con calma.» (13954): a waste of effort, in her view (30899). The character then turns to Dani Tanor.

The Cra rascal bothering Camilo Demolinos («Parlez donc au Gredin Crâ pour «S'interposer»»): «Interponerte» opens the fight against him and two Iop rascals (npc_fights.json); «Comprobar el equipo antes de intervenir» leaves it for later.
The Iop rascal: his only line, glad of the resistance (30914). The Cra one is who is talked to.

Al Etsop, banker of Astrub, from his own lines and replies: his greeting and the bank (BankHandler adds «Quiero consultar mi cofre.»), how an account works (410); and by «Ça tombe à l'eau» («Poser des questions sur le Duc de Sidimote»), a theft (30920), the Sidimote mines (30921) and the real duke long dead, when Abel comes in (30922, 13962: «showsNpc» brings him in); «Seguir escuchando.» turns to him.
Abel Hoz (Delcour Vitt), who comes into the bank as the banker talks: the librarian swindled by an old antique dealer (30924, 13963), and «Dejarles hablar e ir a la biblioteca».

Nosbro Mah (Rodrigue Olpa), sent by the intendant of Amakna, by «Ça tombe à l'eau»: the ambassador of the golden rocks he is after (30928-30930), his description (30931), the same man as the notary and the duke (30932, 13965). Hupe Esse, who delivered the books, breaks in after it («Seguir escuchando.»).

The experienced adventurer idling at Astrub's zaap, by «Six pieds sous terre» of Dofus pour les noobs («interroger l'Aventurière expérimentée»): asked about Hupe Esse's delivery (13967), she saw the antique dealer go by with a group of enutrofs, and Gasdora is who to ask (31480).

Luci (Joséphine in French), one of the three enutrof tourists left in the underground by their guide, by «Six pieds sous terre»: the guide's game of hide-and-seek and the cheese that brought the rats (30942, 13971), «Defender a las turistas de las ratas» (the fight, with the three on the character's side, lost if one of them falls: npc_fights.json), then «¿Estáis bien?» and the promise to take them up (30943, 30944). The way up is walked: the step closes on reaching [1,-17] (13972).
Luci at the surface ([1,-17]), «Six pieds sous terre»: the fresh air (30945), and the guide, met at Kerubim Crepin's shop (30946, 13973): «Ir a casa de Kerubim Crepin».

Bom, the second tourist, in the underground: no cheese left (30937), the guide gone to hide and the rats drawn by the cheese (30938). Her «Defender a las turistas de las ratas» is the same fight as Luci's, once Luci has been talked to (13971).
Pepi, the third tourist, in the underground: how hide-and-seek works (30939), and the rats (30940), the same fight as Luci's once she has been talked to (13971).

Shani Sings, the jeweller of Astrub ([6,-15]), from her own lines and replies: her greeting (31378) and, by «Tel est pris qui croyait prendre», the rumour of the statue (14114): a waste of kamas, in her view (31495).

An Amaknean investigator after the swindler, by «Tel est pris qui croyait prendre» of Dofus pour les noobs («Vous devez trouver un Investigateur Amaknéen qui recherche lui aussi l'escroc»): Kerubim's plan explained (14115), he doubts it but will be there (31497): «Ir al templo».

An Amaknean investigator after the swindler, by «Tel est pris qui croyait prendre» of Dofus pour les noobs («Vous devez trouver un Investigateur Amaknéen qui recherche lui aussi l'escroc»): Kerubim's plan explained (14115), he doubts it but will be there (31720): «Ir al templo».

An Amaknean investigator after the swindler, by «Tel est pris qui croyait prendre» of Dofus pour les noobs («Vous devez trouver un Investigateur Amaknéen qui recherche lui aussi l'escroc»): Kerubim's plan explained (14115), he doubts it but will be there (31725): «Ir al templo».

The investigator at the temple, once Hipo Lítico has talked prices: he recognises him (31498); «Propongo que lo hablemos ante la presencia de la milicia» (14119), the prison first (31500), and back to Hipo.

Hipo Lítico, «responsible for Astrub's religious heritage», who comes to the temple once the rumour has run (14117), by «Tel est pris qui croyait prendre»: the character's name (31389), the card (31390), the statue (31391) and its price (31392), when the accomplices are called in (14118: the investigator comes, 31393). Told he goes to the militia, he is offended (31394): «Llevarlo por la fuerza hasta Bajofrente».
Hipo Lítico behind bars under the militia («Descendez dans le sous-sol pour parler à Hippolyte Hique qui est maintenant en prison»): how he was caught (14121), and Kerubim's miracle pills (31399).

The country doll out of the barn («Parlez à la Poupée Champêtre «Défendre Vaiguy contre la créature et les plantes l'accompagnant»»): the fight against her and a plant of each kind (npc_fights.json); «Pedir refuerzos.» leaves it for when the group is there.

Megustam Laspelas (Emia Elliesol), at the peasants' workshop [7,-24], by «Crise sanitaire»: the bread (13818), the contaminated consumables (30500), every plant and the animals too (30501): «Ir a visitar a Unterix Unter».

Unterix Unter, the hunter of Astrub's outskirts [1,-23], by «Crise sanitaire» («Parler des problèmes avec le bétail»): hunting banned until the game is safe (13819, 21221), and a sample of each resource for Nibe Lula -- wheat, nettle, ash, pío meat with a hunting weapon, gudgeon (21222).

Nibe Lula, the alchemist [3,-21], by «Crise sanitaire»: the five samples handed over all at once (13820, 13821; one missing, 30504): a mould of mineral origin, just after the council refused Chipo Atuf's quarry (30502, 30503); Fidel Gastro's cleaning (13828): the wells, the cereals, the animals (30505), and Paula Sepe is to hear of it (30506).
Chipo Atuf, the miner of Astrub's underground, by «Crise sanitaire»: angry about the subsidy but no poisoner (13822, 21251), and somebody laying in food.

Feldz Paf, the famous miner of the mine at [10,-19], from his own lines: who he is (3455, 3456); by «Crise sanitaire» («Parler des réserves de nourriture»), his food stock (13823, 21252) against the rockslides (21253), and the blocked gallery nearby with crates of explosives to open it (21254).

Fidel Gastro, settled in the abandoned gallery behind the rocks, by «Crise sanitaire»: who blew the rocks (21255), go away (21256), and the mouldy walls scrubbed and the rags washed in the underground river (13827, 21257).
